title: Yale Taiwanese Student Association
content_html:
The Yale Taiwanese Student Association (YTSA, 耶魯臺灣同學會) is a graduate-level student organization at Yale University in New Haven, Connecticut. Its membership is drawn primarily from Taiwanese graduate students and postdoctoral researchers across Yale’s various schools and programs. The organization is registered through Yale’s official GSAS (Graduate School of Arts and Sciences) chapter platform, Yale Connect.

YTSA’s stated focus is on professional networking and mutual support among Taiwanese scholars at Yale. The organization hosts social gatherings — including board game weekends and hot pot parties — to strengthen community ties. All events are open to any interested students. The organization maintains an Instagram presence (@_yale.tsa_) and a Facebook Group, in addition to its official Yale Connect listing.
